Reload.Insufficient: Not enough ammunition in the inventory to reload.
Reload.AoO: Reloading normally provokes an attack of opportunity.
Reload.Unconfigured: Reload tracking is not configured for this weapon.
Reload.SettingsHint: Opt-in tracking for configured firearms and crossbows. Native PF1 continues to consume ammunition. Requires manual per-weapon configuration; disabled by default.
Reload.NoAmmo: No native ammunition Item found in this actor's inventory. Add an Item of type Ammunition (ammo), not a general loot object.
Reload.NoActions: This weapon has no native attack actions. Create an attack action in its PF1 Actions tab first.
Reload.NoNativeAmmo: The weapon's ranged attack has no native ammunition type. Configure its ammunition type in the native PF1 action before saving.
Reload.NativeMismatch: The selected ammunition type does not match the native PF1 ranged attack. Set the attack's Ammo Type to the matching ammunition subtype first.
Reload.Help: Select the ammo Item and optionally an attack requiring multiple shots. Native attack ammunition types must match.
Reload.AutoUnavailable: Unable to determine capacity or ammunition automatically
Reload.InitialStatus: Click Reload to initialize loaded ammunition from the weapon's own data
Reload.AmmoGuidance: Check native PF1 Ammunition Items, their subtype and quantity. The Reload action must have ammunition set to None.

ReloadEnabled.Name: Automatic weapon reload tracking (experimental)
ReloadEnabled.Hint: Opt-in tracking for configured firearms and crossbows. Native PF1 continues to consume ammunition. Requires manual per-weapon configuration; disabled by default.
